categories.main_business_segments: GF Securities operates primarily in four business segments: Investment Banking, Wealth Management, Trading and Institutional Services, and Investment Management. Investment Banking includes equity and debt financing and financial advisory services. Wealth Management covers brokerage, futures brokerage, margin financing, repo transactions, and leasing. Trading and Institutional Services involve equity and fixed income trading, derivatives, alternative investments, research, and asset custody. Investment Management includes asset management, public fund management, and private fund management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced financial technologies including AI applications across 43 scenarios, digital and intelligent transformation in business operations, and proprietary risk management systems. It employs quantitative risk models such as VaR, ES, and SVaR for market risk management. GF Securities also integrates digital platforms for research dissemination and client services, and utilizes blockchain innovation pilots. The firm emphasizes technology-driven innovation in financial product design, trading, and asset management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: GF Securities serves a diverse client base including enterprises, individual investors, institutional investors, financial institutions, and government clients primarily within China. It also serves overseas clients through its Hong Kong and international subsidiaries. Key markets include the Chinese A-share market, Hong Kong stock market, bond markets, and futures markets. The company supports sectors such as technology, green finance, healthcare, and advanced manufacturing, aligning with national strategic priorities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with 330 securities branches covering all 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. It has a strong presence in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, with leading market coverage in the Pearl River Delta. GF Securities also has significant overseas operations through wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the UK, Canada, and other locations, supporting cross-border financial services and international business expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: GF Securities operates primarily as a midstream and downstream financial services provider within the capital markets supply chain. It acts as an intermediary facilitating capital raising, investment, trading, and asset management services. The company provides underwriting, brokerage, advisory, and asset management functions, connecting issuers, investors, and market participants. It also engages in proprietary trading and market making, supporting liquidity and price discovery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities focus on serving national development strategies, enhancing core professional capabilities, and driving digital transformation with AI and fintech innovations. It emphasizes research-driven business models, integration of technology in all business lines, and expansion of wealth management, investment banking, and international business. GF Securities is committed to green finance, pension finance, and digital finance as key innovation themes, alongside strengthening risk management and compliance frameworks.
categories.revenue_model: GF Securities generates revenue through multiple streams including underwriting commissions and advisory fees from investment banking; brokerage commissions and advisory fees from wealth management; investment income and interest from trading and financing activities; and management fees, advisory fees, and performance-based fees from asset and fund management. The company also earns interest income from margin financing and repo transactions, and fees from market making and custody services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: GF Securities is positioned as a leading comprehensive securities firm in China, ranking among the top in key business areas such as research, asset management, wealth management, and investment banking. It competes with other major Chinese securities firms and international financial institutions operating in China. The company holds a strong market position in the Greater Bay Area and maintains competitive advantages through its integrated business model, technological innovation, and extensive branch network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the end of 2024, GF Securities reported total assets of approximately RMB 758.7 billion, an 11.22% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 9.64 billion, up 38.11%. Operating income reached RMB 27.2 billion, growing 16.74% from the prior year. The company’s equity capital stands at over RMB 14.7 billion, with steady growth in revenue and profitability supported by diversified business lines and expanding market share.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: GF Securities emphasizes its strong research-driven approach, comprehensive financial service capabilities, and deep integration of technology to deliver high-quality, innovative financial solutions. It differentiates itself through a robust multi-segment business model, extensive national and international network, and commitment to serving the real economy and national strategic initiatives. The company’s focus on ESG, green finance, and digital transformation further enhances its competitive edge and customer value.
